# Nathan Lambert Archive

> Unofficial static archive of public Facebook posts and videos from Nathan Lambert, the Victorian Labor Member for Preston.

- Posts: {{ site.data.archive.posts | size }} records from {{ oldest_post.date_display }} to {{ newest_post.date_display }}
- Videos: {{ site.data.archive.videos | size }} records from {{ oldest_video.date_display }} to {{ newest_video.date_display }}
- Dates: Melbourne time
- Language: Australian English
- Status: unofficial and not affiliated with Nathan Lambert, the Victorian Government, or the Labor Party

## Use

Each post and video has a permanent page with its date, text or description, and any links found in the Facebook export. Media files and full spoken-word transcripts are not hosted here. A video description is not a transcript.

When citing a record, link to its page and include the record date. The archive is a secondary source. For official statements, use Nathan Lambert's office or parliamentary records.
